snippet.title: Tulpa the Unseen Lover - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4785110/Tulpa_the_Unseen_Lover/

Did you know that you could create life by sheer imagination? In this visual novel, you follow a manga artist who creates a tulpa - a separate being inside his mind - hoping it could fix his 
problems. After all, what can go wrong, especially if the tulpa is this cute?

Tulpa the Unseen Lover is a visual novel in which you read text and make choices that change the story's outcome. It's being developed by a married couple who also happen to be professional animators. Based in Vancouver, BC, we use our expertise and experience (including work on Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, Zootopia 2, Overwatch cinematics, and more) to create interesting characters you'd love to interact with. All CGs and cutscenes are hand-animated in Blender, with no gen-AI.
